bio: After focusing on robotics research at university, I joined SoftBank Corp. in 2020 upon completing my master's degree. For the first four years, I worked on enterprise systems and big-data infrastructure, while also supporting robotics development through the company's internal side-project program. I later moved to Axross, an AI/DX talent development platform, where I worked as a product engineer, instructor, and technical content lead. Through active participation in hackathons, I built a track record of awards and was recognized internally as high-impact technical talent. Since February 2026, after completing an eight-week FDE training program in India, I have focused on company-wide FDE enablement, internal instructor certification, and technical outreach.
